headline: Anthropic shuts loopholes Chinese firms used to reach Claude
body: A quiet day. The FT reported Anthropic is cracking down on Chinese companies reaching Claude through Singapore-linked accounts and VPNs. A wider US-China split weakens Global Coordination, trimming Gatekeeper and nudging Self-Destruction up. Nothing else was scored, so other lines only drifted as older stories faded. Horizon Balance: +1.12.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.1, 1984 -0.1 and Self-Destruction +0.1, all from the Anthropic access crackdown (Gatekeeper -0.13 from that event).
